description: Land Acquisition - Aluthwewa, Danduoya & Galewela, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels and servitudes for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, owners, and measurements. The content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
